findings.claim: The metadata-safety fix leaves one of the requirement's three unguarded `DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0]` accesses unchanged. If the diagnostic branch at line 735 is reached for a metadata symbol, the indexer is evaluated before `ReportIfLocatedInCompilation` can filter the diagnostic, so it can still throw `IndexOutOfRangeException` and cause CS8785/AD0001.

receipt_plan.detail: REQ-2283 identifies unguarded indexing at TypeCollector.cs lines 735, 1009 and 1101 and states that metadata symbols have an empty DeclaringSyntaxReferences collection. The diff changes only the latter two sites (approximately lines 982 and 1074 in the new file); line 735 remains an unguarded [0] access outside the new filtering helper. A two-compilation test that drives a metadata-only symbol through that diagnostic branch should assert no CS8785 or AD0001.
